$comment: Registry of basemap regions. Each region is a PMTiles extract (see docs/OFFLINE_TILES.md). To add a region: extract the pmtiles file for its bbox, upload it to the hosting bucket, and add an entry here. bbox is [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat]; the app picks the basemap by viewport center and validate_data.py checks that every campsite falls inside at least one region's bbox. size_bytes is used for the offline-download button label (Content-Length of the hosted file).
